sentences.en: Speaking of Kyoto, have you ever visited the Kinkakuji Temple?
sentences.zh: 说到京都，你去过金阁寺吗？

sentences.en: Having been to the temple before, I know the way.
sentences.zh: 因为之前去过寺庙，我知道怎么走。

sentences.en: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.
sentences.zh: 但他所说的那座庙宇其实是他的身体。

senses.zh: (Temple)；（法）唐普勒（人名）；（英）坦普尔（人名）
